title: Weeping Cave
wikitext:
[[Image:The Weeping Cavern.jpg|thumb|The Weeping Cavern]]
'''The Weeping Cavern''' is a cave filled with [[Bog Beast|bog beast]]s and [[ooze]]s, and also the location of a rare spawn elemental named [[The Husk]]. The cave is located in northeastern [[Western Plaguelands]], just west of the [[Thondroril River]].
The mobs inside this cave have a low chance to drop {{Loot|Uncommon|Recipe: Greater Nature Protection Potion}}.
